answer: Sybil resistance binds each agent identity to a fresh, remotely verified enclave report: MRENCLAVE hashes the approved code, while platform attestation and anti-replay checks establish genuine hardware. Registration requires a non-exportable hardware-backed key, so duplicating a VM or enclave image cannot create another trusted identity; an attacker must provision additional physical silicon. Names such as walnut, sonnet, and orchard remain labels, not credentials.
